chunks: Al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
One dirham of riba is more severe in the sight of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than thirty acts of fornication, all of them with a forbidden relative such as a maternal aunt or a paternal aunt.

key_terms.بِذَاتِ مَحْرَمٍ: with a person who is a permanently forbidden relative for marriage
key_terms.دِرْهَمٌ: a small unit of money, used here to show that even a tiny amount is grave
key_terms.رِبًا: usury or unlawful increase in a financial transaction

ai.seo_question: How serious is riba in Islam according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that even a small amount of riba is an enormously grave sin before Allah, exalted is He. It emphasizes the severity of usury by comparing it to repeated acts of illicit intercourse involving close forbidden kin.
